name: Helius

notes: Default: the Helius symbol in flat Helius Orange #E84125, the orange of the brand kit. Its shapes match favicon.svg (the same 1.006 aspect); the kit's Helius-Icon.svg draws them about 0.7% narrower and shades each piece from #E35930 to #E84125, a gradient this flat artwork leaves out
Mono: the same shapes in currentColor, as in the kit's one-colour Helius-Icon-Black.svg and Helius-Icon-White.svg
